messages:
Lucas Kim: idea — run a 60m workshop "Serving LLMs: Cost Controls for Product Teams". split into two short tracks (engineering deep-dive + product ROI). audience: infra/platform + product managers at scaleups and mid-market. goal: generate qualified product/infrastructure leads and get 3 demo requests/week for 6 weeks.
Priya Sharma: love the two-track approach. can we make the engineering track hands-on (small lab env) so attendees can see batching/caching in practice?
Rafael Ortiz: agree. propose live lab with a pre-provisioned sandbox. attendees opt-in during registration. need ~2 engineers to monitor sandboxes.
Kim Nguyen: logistics q: where do we host the sandbox? cloud vs ephemeral containers? pref to use a hosted sandbox (quick spin + guaranteed infra) — ops cost estimate?
Evan Brooks: ops note: hosted sandboxes ok if limited seats (50). we'll cap first run. cost estimate attached in drive (I dropped numbers). also recommend recording the lab steps as short clips for on-demand nurture.
Maya Li: run-of-show suggestion (60m):
```
00:00 - intro + outcomes (5m)
05:00 - product narrative: why cost controls matter (10m)
15:00 - eng deep-dive (batching, caching, routing) OR product ROI track (customer story + KPIs) (20m)
35:00 - live lab demo (10m)
45:00 - office hours / breakouts for hands-on (10m)
55:00 - CTA + next steps (5m)
```
Lucas Kim: breakout plan: host two breakout rooms (eng lab + sales-qualified discussion). sign-up field on registration chooses room.
Priya Sharma: registration form fields we need: email, company, job role, company size, cloud infra, hosting preference (hosted/dedicated/private), interest: sandbox? breakout choice. also utm source & campaign.
Rafael Ortiz: CRM routing rules: if hosting_pref == "private" OR company_size > 1000 -> route to Enterprise AE queue. if sandbox_opt_in == true -> tag as "hands-on" and send to Solutions Eng.
Kim Nguyen: snippet for ops webhook mapping: ```form.email -> crm.lead.email
form.company -> crm.lead.company_name
form.hosting_pref -> crm.custom.hosting_interest
form.sandbox_opt_in -> crm.custom.hands_on_flag
utm_campaign -> crm.source.campaign```
Evan Brooks: promo calendar: week -3 announce (email + organic social + partners), week -2 paid ads + partner co-promote, week -1 reminders + targeted invites to accounts, day-of reminder + last-chance. allocate 2 paid bursts (LinkedIn) targeting infra & platform titles.
Maya Li: messaging tests: test two angles for ads & subject lines — "Reduce per-token cost without sacrificing latency" vs "How platform teams make LLM inference predictable". also two landing pages: lab-first (for eng) and outcome-first (for product).measure: CTR, registration -> MQL, demo requests.
Lucas Kim: KPI targets: 600 registrants, 220 attendees, 65 sandbox signups, 30 demo requests, 25% MQL -> SQL motion. reasonable?
Priya Sharma: sounds aggressive but ok for first run if partners help. partner suggestion: invite a customer that did a migration from hosted -> dedicated and saw cost improvement. short 5-7m case study.
Rafael Ortiz: speaker assignments: Lucas = host/exec intro, Priya = product narrative, Evan = ops & analytics, Kim = sandbox ops lead, Maya = comms & promo, Rafael = bench and demo. customer = TBD.
Kim Nguyen: rehearsal cadence: 1 tech check with presenters (20m) 2 days before, 1 full dress (60m) 3 days before including breakout routing. greenroom 15m before.
Evan Brooks: post-webinar nurture: 1) send recording + 3 clips (lab clip, benchmark clip, CTA clip), 2) follow-up sequence: sandbox invite -> 1 week -> demo offer. tag flows for SDR.
Maya Li: creative assets needed: hero banner, 3 social snippets, 1 teaser gif of demo (10s), 2 landing pages. deadline: assets in drive by Tue.
Lucas Kim: tracking & attribution: unique CTA links per slide and per email. also add tracking param on sandbox invites so we know which source drove hands-on signups.
Priya Sharma: ops ask: can eng-oncall be available during live in case sandbox provisioning fails? we should allocate 1 hour of on-call time for the day.
Rafael Ortiz: will book eng-oncall and #webinar-support channel. also will prepare rollback plan: if sandbox errors, move attendees to recorded demo and open Q&A.
Nora-bot: calendar event created: "Serving LLMs: Cost Controls workshop inal rehearsal" scheduled 2024-07-09T16:00Z. Link: https://calendar.redwoodinference/internal/xyz789
Maya Li: outreach plan: ask partners to co-promote via partner newsletter and run a small ABM list for target accounts. also create a short one-pager to share with AEs for targeted outreach.
Lucas Kim: next steps and owners: Priya = sandbox & lab script, Kim = ops + webhook mapping, Rafael = bench + fallback plan, Evan = KPIs & tracking, Maya = creative & promo, I'll own speaker coordination and customer outreach. Share progress in this thread by Wed COB.
Priya Sharma: noted. I'll upload sandbox access instructions and lab steps to the drive tonight.
Kim Nguyen: will confirm capacity and cost numbers by EOD tomorrow.
Rafael Ortiz: prepping bench slides now. will share numbers for review by Tue.
Lucas Kim: great — thanks team. we'll finalize runbook and rehearsal times once assets land. :partyparrot:
